note: Moves the reserved region of the two styles whose declared copy can be made legible by placement alone, and whose repair also survives their motion.
retune_reasons: Measured 2026-08-13: ZERO of the twenty styles that declare an overlay region kept their declared text colour legible, against each style's own threshold. A reserved region is where a designer drops a headline without editing the picture, so a backdrop that cannot carry its own declared copy has not met the written bar however well it reads.

The region's SIZE is the author's decision and is untouched here - a headline needs the room it needs - so only the position moved. `legibility.FindPlacements` swept each region over a 5x5 grid of origins and reported worst-pixel contrast at each; these three are the only styles in the catalog where some position clears the threshold with the colour the style already declares.

ember-mesh moves to x=0.15 y=0.00 and goes from 2.81 to 4.83 against a 4.50 threshold. The mesh darkens toward its lower right, so the copy sat in the gradient's shoulder; at the top it sits on the pale end.
feature-band-mesh moves to x=0.00 y=0.00 and goes from 2.15 to 5.65. It was centred over the band's brightest passage, which is exactly where dark type has least to work with.

pale-moon was moved and then REVERTED, and the reason is worth keeping. The rest-only search found x=0.16 y=0.00 at 6.57, and the real render measured 6.89 there - better than predicted. The parallax-sweep gate then refused it: at full scroll the orb and burst planes rise under the region and contrast falls to 2.38. The placement that fixes a plated style at rest can break it in motion, so the search has to become sweep-aware before it is trusted on a style that moves. The gate caught this on the first repair it was asked about, which is what it exists for.

The other twenty-one styles are NOT repaired here, and no threshold was lowered to pretend otherwise. Every text colour was tried - each style's three ink slots plus pure black and pure white, at every grid position - and not one crosses 4.50; the best lands at 4.49. That is structural: worst-pixel contrast asks about the least legible pixel, and a pictorial backdrop has light and dark pixels nearly everywhere, so dark type meets a dot and light type meets the paper. The repair for those is a region-scoped scrim or a generator that draws a genuinely quiet zone, and both are capability work rather than a seed edit.

Every style's version is incremented so an install that already holds these rows takes the new value. The seed upserts on id and replaces the row, so a version that does not bump is indistinguishable from one that was never applied.
